title: lena roberts - Optimize/Evals 1:1 follow-up notes (2026-03-16)
content:
Meeting: Optimize/Evals 1:1 - follow-up notes
Date: 2026-03-16
Attendees: Lena, Samir (notes), Jamie (joined briefly)

Purpose: recap action items from yesterday's evals review. Focus on the two regressions flagged in A/B test (beta vs prod), prompt set drift, and next steps for triage and re-run.

Summary of issues:
- Regression A: Top-1 answer quality drop on 'customer support' prompt set (~7% drop in Rouge-L, 0.04 BLEU) comparing model-v2-quant vs model-v1-fp16. Observed after kernel change 2026-03-10.
  - Notes: failure cases skew towards hallucinated steps when asked to provide step-by-step remediation. Sample id list: 7123, 7140, 7199.
  - Quick hypothesis: quantization + attention kernel change increased early token entropy; possibly truncation in prefix cache.

- Regression B: Safety filter false positives increased for 'billing' prompts in A/B (beta flagged 3.5% more). Likely due to BPE tokenization change in tokenizer.json introduced in PR #76.
  - Cross-check: same prompts run locally with prod tokenizer -> FP rate matches prod. With new tokenizer -> FP spikes.

A/B results / metrics (quick):
- Prompt set: customer-support (n=1,200)
  - prod: top-1 acc 84.3%
  - beta: top-1 acc 77.1%
- Prompt set: billing (n=600)
  - safety FP: prod 1.1% | beta 4.6%
- Latency: beta median +3ms (within SLO)
- Token cost: beta slightly lower (quant gains)

Action items (owners, due):
- [ ] Samir: triage Regression A samples -> run with debug logs (kv-cache snapshots, logits) and attach to GH issue. Due 2026-03-18. linked: https://github.com/redwood/repro-results/issues/82
- [ ] Lena: revert tokenizer.json change locally and re-run billing prompt set to confirm cause. Due 2026-03-17.
- [ ] Jamie: open infra ticket to add a diff of tokenizer vocab to release checklist. Due 2026-03-19. linked: JIRA-INF-221
- [ ] Eng-serving-runtime: add a KV-cache unit test reproducing prefix truncation pattern. (Need owner assign) Target: 2026-03-24.
- [ ] Product: notify customers on Dedicated with 'no regression observed' note if their traffic uses prod models. (Samir to coordinate)

Open questions / follow-ups:
- Is the quantization profile used in model-v2-quant different across GPUs? Need to verify per-instance kernel selection logs.
- Do we have a golden tokenizer snapshot per model version? If not, let's add to model manifest.
- Can we add a small canary that runs customer-support prompt set on deploy to catch regressions earlier?

Quick repro steps for Samir:
1) checkout PR-76 branch, build model-v2-quant image
2) run reproduce.py --samples 7123,7140,7199 --dump-kv
3) compare logits with prod run (script: tools/compare_logits.py)

Notes to self:
- Keep the follow-ups tight; prioritize Regression A since it affects core UX.
- Prepare a short one-pager for EOD update to Eng and Product with bullet summary (1 slide) + sample failures.
- Add 'evals smoke' to daily CI if we can (discuss with release-engineering next week).

References:
- Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/EVALS/Optimize+Evals+2026
- GH PR: https://github.com/redwood/repro-results/pull/76
- Jira: JIRA-OPT-482 (regression A), JIRA-INF-221 (tokenizer checklist)

Next 1:1 agenda (2026-03-18):
- Triage status updates (5m)
- Prioritization of fixes (5m)
- Canary plan for tokenizer/quant changes (10m)
- Draft customer comms (5m)

-- Lena

(notes: informal; will clean up for PR into confluence after fixes complete)
